in_sanskrit.name: रवितेज

in_telugu.name: రవిజేజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who holds the sun (shashi) and is victorious (hema)

in_marathi.name: RaviTeja
in_marathi.long_meaning: RaviTeja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ravi Teja is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravi' meaning Sun and 'Teja' meaning God. This name signifies the power and might of the Sun God.
